Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Corruption
Description:
Earn XP and arousal when you and a nearby player with the plugin both play animations from mods you each picked in Penumbra. Level through corruption tiers, climax into Cummy layers, bond with a regular partner, spend Sins in the shop, and opt into a full pregnancy system. Everything runs locally.
Requires Penumbra, SimpleHeels and a sync service such as Lightless. Cummy, Glamourer, Moodles and Intiface Central are optional. 18+ content.
Punchline: Earn corruption with someone nearby while your animations play.
Changelog:
- A welcome window walks you through setup once: difficulty, decay, climax and arousal gain, then your anatomy, pregnancy, Cummy layering, the safeword and what shows. Characters set up before it see it once too, and Settings can open it again.
- The HUD shows by itself during a scene with a partner, even with it turned off. Change it in Settings.
- Fixed the HUD's top row overlapping, and long messages and names stretching it.
